subject.title: Feature: Add /models test-fallback command to verify fallback chain

question: Should ordered fallback verification be a distinct `/models` action, or an explicit mode within the broader `models status --probe` diagnostics surface?
rationale: The two open requests share provider-backed probing infrastructure but differ materially: one needs independent per-model health while this issue needs primary-skipped ordered failover semantics. Choosing separate commands versus one typed diagnostics contract is a durable user-facing behavior decision.

options.title: Unify diagnostics with explicit modes
options.body: Extend the existing model-status probe owner with a clearly named ordered-fallback mode, while retaining independent all-model health probing as a separate mode.

options.title: Keep a dedicated slash action
options.body: Add `/models test-fallback` only if maintainers want an in-chat operational action distinct from CLI diagnostics, with its primary-skip and per-candidate semantics documented.

options.title: Defer the surface
options.body: Keep the issue open without implementation until maintainers decide whether proactive provider calls and their costs belong in the core diagnostics UX.

recommendation.title: Unify diagnostics with explicit modes
recommendation.body: Extend the existing model-status probe owner with a clearly named ordered-fallback mode, while retaining independent all-model health probing as a separate mode.

likelyOwner.reason: Their issue comment supplies the clearest source-backed distinction between existing probes and ordered fallback behavior, alongside recent fallback and status work.
